remove-all-annotations-from-pdfs.title: Delete All Annotations from PDFs in a Folder
remove-all-annotations-from-pdfs.description: The example loads each PDF in a specified directory, removes every annotation from all pages, and overwrites the original file with the cleaned document.

delete-text-annotations-from-pdf.title: Delete Text Annotations from PDF
delete-text-annotations-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove only text‑type annotations from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades. The example loads a PDF, deletes annotations named "Text", and saves the result.

remove-link-annotations-from-pdf.title: Remove Link Annotations from Specific PDF Pages
remove-link-annotations-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to delete all link annotations on pages 3 through 7 of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf by iterating the annotation collection and removing matching items.

delete-pdf-annotation-by-name.title: Delete a Specific Annotation from a PDF
delete-pdf-annotation-by-name.description: Shows how to locate an annotation named "Comment1" in a PDF, remove it using Aspose.Pdf, and save the updated document.

export-annotations-to-xfdf-stream.title: Export Annotations from Specific PDF Pages to XFDF Memory Stream
export-annotations-to-xfdf-stream.description: Shows how to export annotations from pages 1 and 2 of a PDF into XFDF format using a memory stream, employing reflection to handle different Aspose.Pdf versions.

import-xfdf-annotations-to-specific-page.title: Import XFDF Annotations to Specific PDF Pages
import-xfdf-annotations-to-specific-page.description: Demonstrates how to read XFDF annotation data, copy the annotations to a selected page range of an existing PDF, and save the result.

import-annotations-without-overwrite.title: Import Annotations Without Overwriting Existing Ones
import-annotations-without-overwrite.description: Shows how to import annotations from a source PDF into a destination PDF while preserving any existing annotations by disabling the overwrite option in the ImportAnnotations configuration.

flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Flatten PDF Annotations to Non‑Editable Elements
flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Shows how to load a PDF, flatten all annotations into static visual content, and save the resulting document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

flatten-annotations-first-five-pages.title: Flatten Annotations on the First Five PDF Pages
flatten-annotations-first-five-pages.description: Shows how to extract the first five pages of a PDF, flatten any annotations on those pages using PdfAnnotationEditor, and then merge them back with the remaining pages.

modify-annotation-author-on-pdf-page.title: Modify Annotation Author on Specific PDF Page
modify-annotation-author-on-pdf-page.description: Shows how to change the author of a particular annotation on a given page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor.

update-annotation-subject-color.title: Update Annotation Subject and Color in PDF
update-annotation-subject-color.description: Demonstrates how to modify a PDF annotation by removing the existing one and adding a new TextAnnotation with a different subject and color.

set-annotation-open-flag.title: Set Open Flag for All Annotations in a PDF
set-annotation-open-flag.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through each page's annotations, and set the Open property on annotation types that support it (e.g., TextAnnotation, PopupAnnotation) before saving the document.

update-annotation-modified-date.title: Update Annotation Modified Date in PDF
update-annotation-modified-date.description: Shows how to load a PDF, locate the first markup annotation, set its Modified property to the current system time, and save the updated document.

set-readonly-flag-on-pdf-text-annotation.title: Set Annotation Read‑Only Flag in PDF
set-readonly-flag-on-pdf-text-annotation.description: Demonstrates how to apply the ReadOnly flag to a PDF annotation using Aspose.Pdf and save the modified document.

batch-update-annotation-author.title: Batch Update Annotation Author Across PDFs
batch-update-annotation-author.description: Demonstrates how to loop through multiple PDF files and use Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor to change the author of every annotation, saving the updated documents to a new folder.

delete-flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Delete and Flatten PDF Annotations
delete-flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, removing all annotations, flattening any remaining ones (e.g., form fields), and saving the result using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-and-valid.title: Validate XFDF File Against an XSD Schema
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-and-valid.description: Demonstrates how to load an exported XFDF file, apply an XSD schema, and report validation errors using XML validation in C#. The example also shows a minimal use of Aspose.Pdf.Facades to satisfy library requirements.

delete-all-annotations-from-pdf.title: Delete All Annotations from a PDF and Verify Removal
delete-all-annotations-from-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, counts its annotations, removes all of them, saves the result, and then reloads the file to confirm that the annotations were successfully deleted.

extract-pdf-annotation-details.title: Extract PDF Annotation Details into Custom Objects
extract-pdf-annotation-details.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page's annotations, and captures the annotation name, type, and bounding rectangle into a user‑defined C# class for further analysis.

delete-pdf-annotation-with-error-handlin.title: Delete Annotation with Error Handling
delete-pdf-annotation-with-error-handlin.description: Demonstrates how to delete a PDF annotation using PdfAnnotationEditor and gracefully handle the exception when the specified annotation ID does not exist.

delete-annotations-by-author.title: Remove Annotations by Author from PDF
delete-annotations-by-author.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating through each page's annotations, filtering by the author stored in the Subject of a MarkupAnnotation, deleting matching annotations, and saving the updated document.

delete-pdf-annotations-by-color.title: Delete Annotations by Color in PDF
delete-pdf-annotations-by-color.description: Shows how to iterate through PDF pages, inspect each annotation's Color property, and remove those that match a specified RGB value using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Batch Flatten PDF Annotations
batch-flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Shows how to iterate over all PDF files in a folder and use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to flatten their annotations, creating new files with a "_flattened" suffix.

batch-delete-stamp-annotations.title: Batch Remove Stamp Annotations from PDFs
batch-delete-stamp-annotations.description: Iterates through all PDF files in a folder, loads each document, finds and deletes every stamp annotation on every page, and saves the cleaned PDF.

delete-pdf-annotations-in-parallel.title: Delete All Annotations from PDFs in Parallel
delete-pdf-annotations-in-parallel.description: Shows how to remove all annotations from multiple PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor together with Parallel.ForEach for faster batch processing.

measure-annotation-flattening-performanc.title: Measure PDF Annotation Flattening Performance
measure-annotation-flattening-performanc.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all annotations in a 500‑page PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor and measure the operation's execution time.

list-pdf-annotation-names.title: List Annotation Names in a PDF
list-pdf-annotation-names.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, retrieve each annotation, and print the annotation's Name property to the console.

delete-annotations-from-pdf.title: Delete All Annotations from a PDF Page
delete-annotations-from-pdf.description: Shows how to create a PDF with text annotations and then remove them using PdfAnnotationEditor within a unit test.

retry-delete-pdf-annotations.title: Retry Deleting PDF Annotations with Rebinding
retry-delete-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to delete all annotations from a PDF and implement a retry mechanism that reloads (rebinds) the document if the first attempt fails.

log-annotation-deletions-to-csv.title: Log and Delete PDF Annotations
log-annotation-deletions-to-csv.description: Shows how to iterate through a PDF, record each annotation's name, type, and page number to a CSV log, delete the annotations, and save the cleaned document.

delete-annotations-from-pdf-using-config.title: Delete Specified Annotations from PDF Using Configuration
delete-annotations-from-pdf-using-config.description: Shows how to read a JSON file that lists annotation types and remove those annotations from a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-delete-pdf-annotations-with-progre.title: Batch Delete PDF Annotations with Progress Indicator
batch-delete-pdf-annotations-with-progre.description: Demonstrates iterating over PDFs in a folder, removing all annotations with PdfAnnotationEditor, and showing a console progress percentage.

batch-flatten-pdf-annotations-cancellati.title: Batch Flatten PDF Annotations with Cancellation Support
batch-flatten-pdf-annotations-cancellati.description: Demonstrates how to flatten annotations in multiple PDF files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades while supporting cancellation via a CancellationToken.

get-annotation-names-by-author.title: Retrieve Annotation Names by Author from a PDF
get-annotation-names-by-author.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating its pages and annotations, filtering markup annotations by the Author (Title) field, and returning the matching annotation names.

copy-annotations-to-multiple-pdfs.title: Copy Annotations from Template PDF to Multiple PDFs
copy-annotations-to-multiple-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to extract annotations from a template PDF, cache them, and import them into several target PDFs, ensuring page count compatibility.

flatten-pdf-annotations-verify-removal.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Verify Removal
flatten-pdf-annotations-verify-removal.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and then validate that no annotation objects remain in the resulting document.

annotation-removal-report.title: Generate PDF Annotation Removal Report
annotation-removal-report.description: The sample counts all annotations in each PDF, removes them using Aspose.Pdf's annotation editor, saves the cleaned files, and creates a CSV report summarizing the number of annotations removed per document.

pdf-annotation-helper.title: PDF Annotation Helper for Deleting, Flattening, and Saving
pdf-annotation-helper.description: Demonstrates a reusable helper class that binds a PDF, removes all annotations, flattens remaining annotations into page content, and saves the result using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

remove-pdf-annotations.title: Remove All Annotations from PDF
remove-pdf-annotations.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to delete every annotation from a PDF stream and return the cleaned document as a MemoryStream.

async-pdf-annotation-operations.title: Add Text Annotation Asynchronously to PDF
async-pdf-annotation-operations.description: Shows how to add a text annotation to a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor wrapped in Task.Run for non‑blocking, asynchronous execution.

delete-pdf-annotations-in-folder.title: Delete All Annotations from PDFs in a Folder
delete-pdf-annotations-in-folder.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor to remove every annotation from each PDF file in a given directory and replace the original files with the cleaned versions.

log-update-annotation-modification-times.title: Log and Update Annotation Modification Timestamps
log-update-annotation-modification-times.description: Shows how to set the Modified property of markup annotations in a PDF and write each change to a log file while iterating through all pages and annotations.

delete-annotations-with-backup.title: Delete All Annotations with Backup Option
delete-annotations-with-backup.description: Demonstrates how to create a backup of the original PDF and then remove all annotations from the document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

delete-pdf-annotations-by-name.title: Delete PDF Annotations by Name
delete-pdf-annotations-by-name.description: Shows how to remove annotations from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades by specifying the annotation name directly as a string literal or via a variable.

benchmark-delete-annotations.title: Benchmark DeleteAnnotation vs DeleteAnnotations Performance
benchmark-delete-annotations.description: Creates a PDF with many text annotations and measures the time required to delete a single annotation using DeleteAnnotation versus removing all annotations with DeleteAnnotations (Clear).

flatten-pdf-annotations-log-size-reducti.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Log Size Reduction
flatten-pdf-annotations-log-size-reducti.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor and log the original and reduced file sizes for audit purposes.

extract-annotation-rectangles-to-pdf.title: Extract Annotation Rectangles to Separate PDF Pages
extract-annotation-rectangles-to-pdf.description: Iterates through all annotations in a PDF, creates a one‑page PDF visualizing each annotation rectangle, and concatenates the pages into a single document for inspection.

add-text-annotation-with-custom-flags.title: Add Custom Annotation Flags to PDF
add-text-annotation-with-custom-flags.description: Demonstrates how to iterate over annotations on a PDF page and set custom flags such as NoView using Aspose.Pdf.

flatten-annotations-network-share.title: Flatten PDF Annotations on a Network Share
flatten-annotations-network-share.description: Shows how to recursively locate PDF files on a UNC share, flatten their annotations using PdfAnnotationEditor, and save the flattened copies while preserving the original folder hierarchy.

flatten-pdf-annotations-verify.title: Flatten PDF Annotations and Verify Removal
flatten-pdf-annotations-verify.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and then validate that no annotation objects remain in the resulting document.

export-pdf-annotations-pretty-xfdf.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF (Pretty‑Printed XML)
export-pdf-annotations-pretty-xfdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, bind it to a PdfAnnotationEditor, and outline the steps for exporting its annotations to an XFDF file with pretty‑printed XML, handling the case where XfdfWriter is unavailable.

pdf-annotation-utility-delete-flatten-ex.title: PDF Utility: Delete Pages, Flatten Forms, Export PNG Images
pdf-annotation-utility-delete-flatten-ex.description: A command‑line example that demonstrates how to delete specific pages, flatten interactive form fields, and export each PDF page as a PNG image using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-multiple-xfdf-files.title: Merge Multiple XFDF Files into a Single XFDF
merge-multiple-xfdf-files.description: Demonstrates how to import annotations from several XFDF files into a PDF, accumulate them, and then export the combined annotations as one merged XFDF file.

export-import-flatten-pdf-annotations-lo.title: Add Text Annotation with Diagnostic Logging
export-import-flatten-pdf-annotations-lo.description: Demonstrates how to add a text annotation to a PDF using PdfAnnotationEditor while logging each step of the workflow to a verbose log file.

retrieve-annotation-count-per-pdf-page.title: Get Annotation Count Per PDF Page
retrieve-annotation-count-per-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and retrieve the number of annotations on each page for reporting purposes.

clone-modify-pdf-annotation.title: Clone and Modify PDF Annotation
clone-modify-pdf-annotation.description: Shows how to clone the first text annotation on a PDF page, change its title, contents and other properties, and add the cloned annotation back to the same page using Aspose.Pdf.

concurrent-insert-delete-pdf.title: Concurrent Import and Delete Operations on a PDF
concurrent-insert-delete-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to run multiple import and delete operations on the same PDF file concurrently using Aspose.Pdf.Facades with a lock to ensure thread safety.

backup-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.title: Backup PDF and Flatten Annotations
backup-pdf-and-flatten-form-fields.description: Shows how to create a backup of a PDF file before flattening its annotations using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

get-annotation-counts-from-pdf.title: Count PDF Annotation Types
get-annotation-counts-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, walk through each page's annotations, and produce a dictionary that maps annotation type names to their occurrence counts.

skip-readonly-annotations-when-flattenin.title: Skip Flattening Read‑Only Annotations in PDF Batch Processing
skip-readonly-annotations-when-flattenin.description: Demonstrates how to preserve read‑only PDF annotations while flattening all other annotations during a batch conversion, using Aspose.Pdf's annotation editor and runtime reflection.

log-pdf-annotation-operations-duration.title: Log Duration of PDF Annotation Operations
log-pdf-annotation-operations-duration.description: Demonstrates wrapping annotation actions such as adding a text annotation and an image stamp with a Stopwatch‑based logger to record execution time, then saves the modified PDF.

delete-annotations-export-xfdf.title: Delete Text Annotations and Export Remaining to XFDF
delete-annotations-export-xfdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove all Free‑Text (Text) annotations from a PDF document and then export the remaining annotations to an XFDF file using Aspose.Pdf.

retry-annotation-modification-exponentia.title: Add Text Annotation with Retry and Exponential Backoff
retry-annotation-modification-exponentia.description: Demonstrates how to add a TextAnnotation to a PDF page while handling transient file‑access errors using an exponential backoff retry policy.

list-pdf-annotations-to-csv.title: List PDF Annotations with Page Numbers to CSV
list-pdf-annotations-to-csv.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, retrieve each annotation's name (or type), and write the page number and annotation name to a CSV file.

batch-remove-old-annotations.title: Batch Remove Old PDF Annotations
batch-remove-old-annotations.description: Shows how to scan PDFs in a folder, find annotations older than a specified number of days, and delete them using Aspose.Pdf's Document and PdfAnnotationEditor APIs.

check-duplicate-annotation-names.title: Check Duplicate Annotation Names in PDF
check-duplicate-annotation-names.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all pages and their annotations, and reports any annotation names that appear on multiple pages.

extract-pdf-annotation-comments-summary.title: Extract PDF Annotations and Generate a Summary PDF
extract-pdf-annotation-comments-summary.description: The example loads a PDF, collects all text annotations (comments) from every page, and creates a new PDF that lists each annotation with its title and content.

merge-annotation-layers-from-multiple-pd.title: Merge Annotations from Multiple PDFs
merge-annotation-layers-from-multiple-pd.description: Demonstrates how to combine annotation layers from several PDF files into a single PDF by copying annotations page‑by‑page using Aspose.Pdf.

pdfannotationeditor-health-check.title: Verify PdfAnnotationEditor Binding to a PDF
pdfannotationeditor-health-check.description: Demonstrates a simple health check that creates a PdfAnnotationEditor, binds it to a sample PDF, and saves the result to ensure no binding errors occur.

batch-export-delete-annotations-xfdf.title: Export, Delete and Archive PDF Annotations to XFDF
batch-export-delete-annotations-xfdf.description: Demonstrates a batch process that copies PDFs, exports their annotations to XFDF files, removes all annotations from the PDFs, and then archives the XFDF files into a ZIP package.

flatten-pdfs-save-to-custom-output-direc.title: Flatten PDF and Save to Custom Output Directory
flatten-pdfs-save-to-custom-output-direc.description: Demonstrates how to flatten a PDF (remove annotations and form fields) using Aspose.Pdf and save the result to a user‑specified output folder while preserving the original file name.

log-file-sizes-after-flattening-pdf-anno.title: Log File Sizes After PDF Annotation Flattening
log-file-sizes-after-flattening-pdf-anno.description: Demonstrates how to flatten all annotations in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and log the original and resulting file sizes for audit purposes.

update-annotation-subject.title: Unit Test for Updating PDF Annotation Subject
update-annotation-subject.description: Demonstrates how to create a PDF with a TextAnnotation, modify its Subject property via MarkupAnnotation, and verify the change using a unit test.

batch-delete-pdf-annotations-retain-type.title: Batch Delete PDF Annotations Except Specified Types
batch-delete-pdf-annotations-retain-type.description: Loads a JSON configuration that lists annotation types to keep, iterates through each page of a PDF, and removes all annotations not in the retain list, then saves the cleaned document.

flatten-pdf-annotations-from-stream.title: Flatten PDF Annotations to Stream
flatten-pdf-annotations-from-stream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a stream, flattening all annotations with PdfAnnotationEditor, and returning the modified PDF as a MemoryStream without creating any temporary files.

flatten-pdf-tag-flattened-date.title: Flatten PDF and Add Flatten Date Metadata
flatten-pdf-tag-flattened-date.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, flatten its form fields and annotations, add a custom "FlattenDate" metadata entry with the current UTC timestamp, and save the updated document.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-with-diag.title: Export PDF Form Data to XFDF with Diagnostic Logging
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-with-diag.description: Demonstrates how to export PDF form data to an XFDF file using Aspose.Pdf and write the full XFDF content to a diagnostic log after each export.

clone-annotation-change-color.title: Clone Annotation, Change Color, and Add to Another PDF Page
clone-annotation-change-color.description: Demonstrates how to clone an existing annotation from a source PDF, modify its color, and insert the cloned annotation into a different page of a destination PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-delete-pdf-annotations-azure-blob.title: Batch Add Text Annotation to PDFs in Azure Blob Storage
batch-delete-pdf-annotations-azure-blob.description: Streams PDF blobs from an Azure Blob container, binds each to Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor, adds a text annotation, and uploads the modified PDF back to the same blob.

generate-annotation-summary-report.title: Generate Annotation Summary Report for PDF Files
generate-annotation-summary-report.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages and annotations, count each annotation type, and output a concise summary report.

conditional-pdf-flattening.title: Conditional PDF Flattening Preserving Digital Signatures
conditional-pdf-flattening.description: Loads a PDF, checks for digital signature fields and skips flattening to keep signatures valid; otherwise it flattens form fields and annotations and saves the result.

rename-pdf-annotation-names.title: Batch Rename PDF Annotation Names with Standard Prefix
rename-pdf-annotation-names.description: Loads each PDF in a folder, iterates through all pages and annotations, and assigns a standardized prefixed name with a unique counter. The modified PDFs are saved to an output directory.

manage-pdf-annotations-verbose.title: Add Text Annotations to PDF Pages with Verbose Logging
manage-pdf-annotations-verbose.description: Shows how to load a PDF, add a text annotation to each page, and optionally output detailed operation logs using a --verbose command‑line flag.

test-export-annotations-unbound-editor.title: Test ExportAnnotations Throws Exception on Unbound PdfAnnotationEditor
test-export-annotations-unbound-editor.description: Demonstrates how to verify that calling ExportAnnotations on a PdfAnnotationEditor that hasn't been bound to a PDF document throws an exception, using reflection to invoke the method.

report-pdf-annotations-by-author.title: Report PDF Annotations Grouped by Author
report-pdf-annotations-by-author.description: Extracts all annotations from a PDF, groups them by the author (using the Subject property), and prints a summary report with annotation type, title and page number.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-custom-na.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF with Custom Namespace
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf-custom-na.description: Demonstrates how to export PDF annotations to an XFDF file and replace the default XFDF namespace with a custom one required by enterprise XML standards.

monitor-folder-flatten-pdf-annotations.title: Folder Watcher to Flatten PDF Annotations
monitor-folder-flatten-pdf-annotations.description: Monitors a directory for newly created PDF files and automatically flattens (or removes) their annotations using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfAnnotationEditor.

validate-pdf-integrity-after-annotation.title: Validate PDF Integrity After Annotations
validate-pdf-integrity-after-annotation.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf to validate a PDF for corrupted objects after annotation modifications, optionally creating an XML validation report.

export-pdf-annotations-to-compressed-xfd.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF and GZip Compress
export-pdf-annotations-to-compressed-xfd.description: Demonstrates how to export annotations from a PDF to an XFDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Xfdf via reflection, then compress the XFDF output with GZip for efficient storage.

import-xfdf-into-pdf-cleanup.title: Import XFDF Annotations and Cleanup Temporary Files
import-xfdf-into-pdf-cleanup.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF, import one or more XFDF annotation files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfXfdfForm, save the updated PDF, and delete the XFDF files after a successful import.

pdf-annotation-editor-wrapper.title: PDF Annotation Wrapper for Adding, Deleting, and Flattening Annotations
pdf-annotation-editor-wrapper.description: Demonstrates a custom wrapper that abstracts Aspose.Pdf's PdfAnnotationEditor and Document APIs to add text annotations, delete single or all annotations, flatten them, and save the PDF.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v3.title: Remove All Annotations from a PDF
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to bind a PDF to PdfAnnotationEditor, delete every annotation, and save the cleaned document to a new file.

delete-pdf-annotation-by-name__v2.title: Delete PDF Annotation by Name using Aspose.Pdf
delete-pdf-annotation-by-name__v2.description: Demonstrates how to remove a specific annotation from a PDF by passing its name to the DeleteAnnotation method of PdfAnnotationEditor.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v4.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v4.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and exporting all its annotations to an XFDF file using the XfdfWriter class.

import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf__v3.title: Import XFDF Annotations into PDF
import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdf__v3.description: Shows how to bind an existing PDF with PdfAnnotationEditor, import annotations from an XFDF file, and save the updated document.

export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v5.title: Export PDF Annotations to XFDF Using MemoryStream
export-pdf-annotations-to-xfdf__v5.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a byte array, export its annotations to XFDF via the Aspose.Pdf.Xfdf assembly, and return the XFDF data as a byte array.

export-pdf-annotations-to-json__v2.title: Extract PDF Annotations to JSON Log
export-pdf-annotations-to-json__v2.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through all pages and their annotations, extracts key properties (type, rectangle, contents, title, subject) and writes the data as a pretty‑printed JSON file for auditing.

export-import-pdf-annotations-xfdf__v2.title: Export and Import PDF Annotations via XFDF
export-import-pdf-annotations-xfdf__v2.description: Shows how to export annotations from a source PDF to an XFDF file and then import that XFDF into another PDF to duplicate the annotation layout.

import-xfdf-annotations-into-multiple-pd.title: Import XFDF Annotations into Multiple PDFs
import-xfdf-annotations-into-multiple-pd.description: Shows how to load a single XFDF file containing reviewer comments and apply those annotations to several PDF documents, saving the annotated versions to an output folder.

remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v4.title: Remove All Annotations from PDF
remove-all-annotations-from-pdf__v4.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate through each page, delete all annotations, and save the cleaned document using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs_.title: Batch Import XFDF Data into Matching PDFs
batch-import-xfdf-annotations-into-pdfs_.description: Demonstrates iterating over a folder, matching each PDF with an XFDF file of the same name, importing the XFDF data using the Form facade, and saving the updated PDFs.

flatten-pdf-annotations__v2.title: Flatten PDF Annotations While Preserving Appearance
flatten-pdf-annotations__v2.description: Demonstrates how to convert interactive PDF annotations into static graphics, keeping their visual appearance, by using Aspose.Pdf's annotation editor to flatten them.
